question: The Bishnoi community contributes to forest and animal conservation in _______ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Bishnoi community **is known for their beliefs in protecting the** environment and wildlife **in **Rajasthan.**
 
• They follow the principle of **"Jeev Daya"** which means compassion towards all living beings. 
 
• The community has a long history of** conservation efforts**, dating back to the 15th century, when their founder **Guru Jambheshwar** preached about the importance of protecting nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **Rajasthan,** the Bishnoi community has played a significant role in protecting the** Khejri trees, **which are considered** sacred by them** and are also essential for the ecosystem. 
 
• They also protect the** blackbuck antelope**, which is a **symbol** of their community, and have even sacrificed their lives to protect them from hunters.
 
• Apart from Rajasthan, the Bishnoi community is also present in parts of **Haryana, Punjab, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh**, where they continue to contribute to conservation efforts.
